name: hllmr-web
description: HLLMR static websites: shared design package and per-site Astro builds (silo.hllmr.com, hllmr.com).

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:contract
scripts.check: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/silo/dist && html-validate "sites/silo/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/silo/dist && node scripts/gen-nginx-redirects.mjs --check
scripts.check:hllmr: node scripts/check-built-html.mjs sites/hllmr/dist && html-validate "sites/hllmr/dist/**/*.html" && node scripts/check-internal-links.mjs sites/hllmr/dist
scripts.test:hllmr: npm run build:hllmr && npm run check:hllmr && node --test tests/url-contract/hllmr.contract.mjs
